dreamer-effigy.summary: A peaceful head sculpted from smooth lavender rounded blocks with an open graphic third eye on its brow.
dreamer-effigy.pose: Upright head perched quietly facing directly south toward the entry axis with peaceful downcast eyes.

smoke-ribbon-pillar.summary: Stacked twisting translucent lavender lozenge blocks mimicking the serpentine S-curve smoke line.

candlestick-dais.summary: Faceted glass cylinder with a pale label box and miniature gold flame cone.

spotted-neon-cap.summary: Chunky cylindrical stalk supporting a domed mint-green mushroom cap dotted with bright yellow beads.

eyeball-totem.summary: Faceted black prism frame enclosing a concentric low-poly eyeball with cyan iris and dark pupil.

orb-cluster-crest.summary: Slender dark totem pole capped with a cluster of bright colored spheres in teal, yellow, and magenta.

things.text: A crowned thought, folded small, humming periwinkle.
